# Worked solution — Agents SDK: own the runtime

- The managed Agents API is a reasonable choice for the hosted worker when its access, retention, environment, and billing fit. The application still controls tool validation and authorization.
- The Agents SDK is a reasonable choice for an existing application with custom storage and permissions. Persist SDK-compatible history or use a supported SDK session strategy; the classroom demo keeps local history only. Responses is also defensible when explicit loop control is the priority.
- An unavailable PDF must not silently turn a CSV summary into primary-paper evidence. Inspect tool_calls, not_found, limitations, and citations; repair any unsupported claim.

These are assessment criteria; live model wording and tool order can vary. Check actual source evidence.
